title: Catena-X Battery Pass aspect model
usedFor: Candidate semanticId for the battery submodel template in the AAS projection.
licence: CC-BY-4.0. Eclipse Foundation governance; no membership required to use the models. Attribution attaches to reuse of model content, not to referencing the identifier.
finding: The only third-party identifier this project has ever checked and found clean: correct SAMM URN form, real released version, current at 6.0.0, and a licence that is actually stated. It is nonetheless not adopted — correspondence between the aspect model's field set and our battery submodel was never established, so the semantic claim would be unsupported even though the identifier is valid. A well-formed identifier attached to a mismatched concept is still a false statement to a machine.
nextStep: Compare the aspect model's field set against our battery submodel. If they correspond, this becomes the first verified entry in this directory.
